purpose: Preserve the joint multi-reference VLM ranking and use source-bound judges only to veto candidates that fail a source more extremely than every development positive.
transfer_origin: Selective prediction and conformal risk control, adapted to source-specific constraint verification in multi-reference composed retrieval.
direct_prior_boundaries: Constraint-verification reranking already exists for single-reference fashion CIR.
Conformal candidate sets and uncertainty calibration already exist for single-reference CIR and generic multimodal retrieval.
The candidate contribution is therefore limited to source-bound multi-reference vetoing, interaction-preserving ranking, explicit-negative evaluation, and staged component-disjoint validation.

method.joint_score: raw labelled_dual True-minus-False margin with both references and candidate visible
method.source_score: weak=min(m_source1,m_source2), using the frozen P035 source prompts

calibration.source: 21 positive candidates in the P030 development top20
calibration.candidate_level_exchangeability_caveat: Candidates share queries and reference components; call this risk-inspired calibration, not a formal distribution-free guarantee.
calibration.veto_rule: veto iff p_value <= alpha, equivalently weak < threshold

method.ranking: Place non-vetoed top20 candidates first and vetoed candidates second; preserve descending joint_score within each block; append original ranks 21-50 unchanged.

split.procedure: metadata-only positive-component balancing plus hash/row balancing; no reserved model scores
split.confirmation_execution_rule: Score confirmation images only if every frozen development gate passes.

development_gate.meaning: Eligibility to access confirmation images; not significance, novelty, or SOTA.

fixed_secondary_controls: pure weak-source min-margin ranking (P035 direct copy)
pure probabilistic AND ranking (P035 direct copy)
uncalibrated zero-threshold source veto preserving joint order
